title: Free Storage Period Allowed on a Retrofit Project
content:
# Free Storage Period Allowed on a Retrofit Project

The free period on storage held for a project under Equipment Replacement & Retrofit Projects depends on whether the building is covered by one of the company's Preventive Maintenance Agreements and on whether the project has carried a late fee in the year before the charge.

## The three cases

1. Where an active maintenance agreement covers the building and no late fee has been raised on the project in the twelve months before the charge, the free period is **3 weeks**.
2. Where an active maintenance agreement covers the building and a late fee has been raised on the project in those twelve months, the free period is **2 weeks**.
3. Where no active maintenance agreement covers the building, the free period is **1 week**.

The agreement read is the Preventive Maintenance Agreement standing at the same building, taken from that agreement's own holding record, and it counts for this rule only while it stands active. The late fees counted are the late fee lines standing on this project's own billing record whose due day falls inside the twelve months before the charge; a single such line is enough to put the project in the second case.

## Condition table

| Maintenance agreement at the building | Late fee on the project in the twelve months before the charge | Free period |
|---|---|---|
| active | none | 3 weeks |
| active | one or more | 2 weeks |
| none active | none | 1 week |
| none active | one or more | 1 week |

Where no active agreement covers the building, the project's late fee history makes no difference: the free period is 1 week either way.

## Cases (hypothetical)

- An owner whose building carries an active Preventive Maintenance Agreement and whose project shows no late fee line in the last twelve months is allowed 3 weeks free.
- The same building and agreement, with one late fee line raised on the project seven months ago: 2 weeks free.
- A building with no maintenance agreement at all: 1 week free.
